name: Pogo Jump
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Bounce lightly off the balls of your feet, keeping the knees nearly straight.
Use quick ankle action with minimal ground contact time.
Stay relaxed through the shoulders and continue 20-30 seconds, staying springy.
longevityNotes: Cardiorespiratory fitness is one of the strongest known predictors of longevity. Short, regular conditioning sessions compound enormously over a lifetime.
overview: Pogo Jump is a beginner conditioning exercise performed with just your bodyweight, engaging the calves. It raises the heart rate while building work capacity and coordination.
